IncidentBot: PAGER — Severity: P1. 1728249999 — alert: interregion-routing bouncechain detected between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Autoretries observed 412 events in last 5m. Possible health-check flapping combined with model-variant fallback. Paging @oncall.
Sara (oncall): I’m awake. looking now. any customer-facing errors?
Maya (support): Multiple customers reporting elevated latencies and "model mismatch" errors in logs. CS tickets 7891, 7902. Has anyone seen a config change?
Jorge (sre): pulling telemetry. probes show eu health probe failing every ~20s then recovery. us-east/backoff triggers routing to us-west then back to eu — loop. seeing model-variant mismatch 503s on the hot path when region switches.
Priya (eng-runtime): We rolled a quantized variant (v2q) to eu yesterday 23:40 UTC behind a canary. Healthcheck path changed to /health/fast — might be marginally slower under cold start.
Alex (devex): so fallback policy tries variant compatibility across regions and ends up evicting caches, causing more cold starts -> failing health checks -> repeat.
Sara (oncall): hypothesis: variant mismatch + aggressive fallback policy = ping-pong. Immediate mitigation idea: temporarily disable cross-region variant fallback and prefer region-local model variants, and widen probe success window.
Nikhil (platform): I can flip a routing override. How fast do you want it? We can set a global policy for 10m.
Sara (oncall): Do it. set: prefer_region_local=true, cross_variant_fallback=disabled, probe_success_threshold=3 -> 60s. Apply for 15m and monitor.
Nikhil (platform): running now.
Nikhil (platform): ```
# apply global routing override via control-plane
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/overrides" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" -d '{"scope":"global","overrides": {"prefer_region_local":true,"cross_variant_fallback":"disabled","probe_success_threshold":3},"ttl_s":900 }'
```
IncidentBot: control-plane: override created id=ovr-202603141230, effective in 4s.
Jorge (sre): telemetry: probe flaps drop ~90% within 30s of override. Aggregated retries down from 412 to 18 in 3m. Seeing fewer evictions.
Priya (eng-runtime): For a durable fix we should roll back the v2q canary in eu or align its health endpoint/timeout. Rolling back canary would be low-risk.
Alex (devex): Customers on EU-heavy traffic saw latency regressions. We should route EU customers to eu-primary variant only and avoid cross-region spill for those tenants until patch.
Maya (support): I'll notify top impacted customers with a short note: "We're investigating an infrastructure routing loop; temporary routing changes applied; minimal impact expected; will follow up." Drafting now.
Sara (oncall): Agreed. Action items: (1) Nikhil keep override for 15m and extend if healthy (owner: Nikhil). (2) Priya rollback or reconfigure v2q canary in eu (owner: Priya). (3) Jorge keep monitoring and collect probe traces (owner: Jorge). (4) Maya notify customers and CS ops (owner: Maya). (5) Alex to prepare post-incident evaluation of fallback policy thresholds (owner: Alex).
Priya (eng-runtime): Starting canary rollback now. ```
# rollback canary
kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/serve-eu runtime-model=redwood/model:stable-v2
kubectl -n runtime rollout status deployment/serve-eu
```
Priya (eng-runtime): rollback initiated, rollout progressing.
Jorge (sre): logs show variant eviction errors dropping. Probe success back to normal for eu. I'll keep 1m cadence for 10m.
IncidentBot: auto-update: incident status -> mitigation in place. linked pager: 1728249999. runbook: interregion-routing-bouncechain.
Maya (support): customer note sent to 2 paying customers + a PSA to the broader affected list.
Sara (oncall): Priya, confirm when rollout completes.
Priya (eng-runtime): rollout finished at 1728250320. healthchecks stable.
Nikhil (platform): leaving override to expire at 1728250899 (we set TTL 900s). Will extend if needed.
Jorge (sre): no more bouncechain spikes for 10m. metrics look back to baseline. closing the on-call blip.
Sara (oncall): I'll mark incident as mitigated. Postmortem owners: Priya (root cause: canary health mismatch), Alex (routing policy design), Jorge (telemetry gaps), Nikhil (control-plane override hygiene), Maya (customer comms). Scheduled 24h post-incident.
IncidentBot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. Final note: create postmortem ticket and link runbook. :white_check_mark:
Sara (oncall): thanks team. tagging this thread for the postmortem notes.
